verdict.rationale: Audit of who ran what is well documented. The Query History page monitors queries executed by users, covering the last 14 days, and the ACCESS_HISTORY view records user reads and write operations, explicitly for compliance auditing, including which tables and columns are accessed. Column-level lineage of where data came from is only implied by Access History's read/write and column records; no doc explicitly describes source-to-target column lineage. missing for 10: explicit column-level lineage documentation (source-to-target column mapping), retention details for Access History, independent or hands-on corroboration.
